3. Description of the Service

Remvoll generates layered, procedurally varied ambient soundscapes with an audible slow-modulation feature marketed as "Breath Entrainment" (a breaths-per-minute pacing cue) together with a "Drift" spectral-variation feature, a library of environments, user-created presets, alarms including Smart Wake, an on-device Sleep Score and sleep history, optional microphone-based room listening, app blocking through Apple's Screen Time, optional reminders, Siri and Shortcuts actions, and related conveniences. Features vary by membership tier and may be added, changed, improved, or discontinued over time in our reasonable discretion. We will not, however, remove core overnight playback from any paid tier during a period you have paid for. The Service is provided for personal, non-commercial entertainment, comfort, and ambiance purposes only.

4. Not a medical device or health service

THE SERVICE IS NOT A MEDICAL DEVICE AND IS NOT INTENDED TO DIAGNOSE, TREAT, CURE, MITIGATE, OR PREVENT ANY DISEASE, DISORDER, OR HEALTH CONDITION. It is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment, and it does not provide therapy, sleep-medicine services, or clinical monitoring. The "Breath Entrainment" feature is an audible pacing cue you may voluntarily breathe along with; it does not monitor, measure, or force your respiration, and it does not measure or alter your brain activity. Remvoll contains no sensors of its own. With your explicit permission it can READ what your own devices already record in Apple Health — sleep and heart rate, and overnight heart rate variability, breathing rate, blood oxygen and wrist temperature, as recorded by an Apple Watch or another device or app that writes to Health — solely so Smart Wake can choose a moment inside your wake window and so the Sleep Score can show how you slept; that access is read-only, Remvoll never writes to Health, and those samples are used on your device and never transmitted. If you do not grant Health access, Smart Wake works from sleep-cycle timing and optional on-device room-loudness readings instead, and the Sleep Score is based on how long the sound played rather than on how long you slept. The Sleep Score is a wellness estimate of how restful a night was, built from what the app and, where you allow it, your tracker recorded; it is not a medical measurement or an assessment of your health. Overnight body readings are shown as your tracker recorded them and are not used in the score. Always seek the advice of a qualified health provider with any questions regarding a medical or psychological condition, and never disregard or delay seeking such advice because of anything you have accessed through the Service. THE SERVICE HAS NOT BEEN CLINICALLY TESTED OR EVALUATED IN ANY CLINICAL TRIAL; ANY BENEFITS ARE NOT SCIENTIFICALLY PROVEN, AND NO RESULTS OR OUTCOMES ARE GUARANTEED. See the full Wellness Disclaimer, which is incorporated into these Terms.

5. No accounts, and what that means for you

  • There is no Remvoll account. This app has no sign-up, no password, no recovery code and no profile. Nothing about you is registered with us, because there is nothing to register with.
  • Your data is identified by your device, not by an identity we hold. Everything the app produces lives in its own storage on your iPhone.
  • Anyone who can unlock your iPhone can open Remvoll and see what is in it. Protect the device with a passcode, Face ID or Touch ID; that lock is what protects the app.
  • If you delete the app, or reset or lose the device, the data goes with it. There is no server-side copy for us to restore. Use Settings › Export my data to keep anything you care about.
  • Your subscription, if you buy one, is attached to your Apple Account rather than to any account with us, which is why it restores on a new device through Apple.

9. Free trial

Remvoll may be offered with a one-month free trial, once per Apple Account across both plans. You are not charged during the trial. If you switch plans during a free trial, the trial ends and the new plan begins right away. Eligibility is determined by Apple, not by us, and the app shows you whether a trial applies before you buy: we cannot grant, extend or reissue one.

A trial converts into a paid subscription automatically when it ends, unless you cancel at least 24 hours before that. Cancel in Settings › your name › Subscriptions, and you keep access until the trial period is over and pay nothing. If you allow notifications, Remvoll reminds you two days before your free trial ends.

10. Subscriptions, billing, and automatic renewal

  • Plans. After the trial, continued access to playback requires an active subscription. There is no permanently free tier. Current plans and prices are displayed in the application at the time of purchase and govern that purchase; the full sound engine and Breath Entrainment are included in every tier.
  • Authorization and renewal. By starting a paid subscription you authorize Apple to charge your Apple Account the then-current price on a recurring basis (monthly or yearly, as chosen) until you cancel. Subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each billing period unless canceled at least 24 hours before that period ends.
  • Apple bills, not us. Every subscription is sold through the App Store, billed to your Apple Account, and subject to Apple's terms, including its cancellation and refund rules. Remvoll never sees or handles your payment details and cannot charge, refund or cancel anything on your behalf. Manage or cancel in Settings › your name › Subscriptions.
  • Taxes. Prices exclude applicable taxes and similar charges, which may be added.

For existing subscribers, we will give at least 30 days' advance notice in-app or by other reasonable means, and the new price will apply only from the next renewal after the notice period. 12. Health, safety, and responsible use

  • Do not use the Service while driving, operating machinery, or in any circumstance requiring your full attention or the ability to hear your surroundings and alarms.
  • Choose a volume that preserves your ability to hear smoke, carbon-monoxide, security, and other alarms, as well as caregiving needs, throughout the night. Prolonged listening at high volume, particularly through headphones or earbuds, may harm your hearing.
  • A small number of people are sensitive to certain sounds or to low-frequency content. If you experience discomfort, distress, headache, dizziness, or any adverse reaction, stop using the Service and consult a professional if symptoms persist.
